Thanks Mira — this is a great start and the attachments look good.

A few clarifications before we activate PO routing for your account:

1) Invoicing entity: Can you confirm which legal entity you want Redwood to issue POs to? We have a couple of remit options for EMEA (Redwood Inference Ltd and Redwood Inc). The PO must match your VAT registration name for auto-match.
2) Tax residency: We require either a signed tax residency declaration or a scanned company registration certificate that shows the Hungarian tax office registration. If you can provide the signed declaration it speeds up VAT/reverse-charge handling.
3) Reverse charge applicability: Please confirm whether you will issue invoices with the reverse-charge note ("VAT reverse charge applies under Art. 196 VAT Directive") or whether you want Redwood to self-account. If you prefer reverse charge, we need the invoice language and VAT clause for our AR team to program the matching rules.
4) Bank verification: Ben in finance will run the IBAN through our vendor bank-screening. If the account name differs from the legal name, include a short note explaining the remit-to structure.

Next steps: once we have the signed tax residency doc and the preferred remit entity, Procurement will enable PO creation (we aim to have first PO issued within 3 business days after verification).

Thanks — copying Ben and Kimberly to assist with bank/PO activation.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Adding a couple of items from finance side:

- Please attach a company registration extract that shows the company number and the VAT registration reference (if different from VAT number already provided).
- If the IBAN belongs to a different legal name (e.g., a treasury/collection account), we need a bank letter or a short remit note on company letterhead.
- Our standard PO terms for international suppliers are Net 60 unless an alternate agreed term is in the contract. Confirm if EuroLogistics requires a different term; we can flag it on the PO but exceptions need approval.
- For VAT handling: Mina, can you confirm the invoice field mapping required to detect the Hungarian reverse-charge language? We want the matching rule to accept invoices that include the phrase "reverse charge" or the article reference.

Action items:
- Priyom: hold PO activation until both company registration and tax residency declaration are received.
- Mira: please upload Incorporation_Certificate.pdf and a signed Tax_Residency_Declaration.pdf (if available) into the supplier portal or reply to this thread.
